description:
Because:

* The deprecated mysql driver is still a dependency of four packages.

This commit:

* Moves every direct import and knex client from mysql to mysql2.
* Returns JSON columns as strings from the knex typeCast functions.
* Closes idle OAuth pool connections with PoolConnection.destroy().
* Keeps knex pool keys out of the mysql2 connection settings.
* Removes mysql and @types/mysql and updates yarn.lock.

Closes FXA-13447
